correctness.rationale: All rank-n-1 idempotents are exactly the 3 per unordered pair diagram types. Products cannot increase rank. Rank preservation fixes the first upper kernel and last lower equivalence, forcing every merge projector and at least one oriented collapse per unordered pair. A strong-tournament Howie generating set together with Proposition 6.6 factorization gives the matching all-n upper bound. The n=2 case is a three-element right-zero semigroup. Independent partition-diagram multiplication code confirmed the precise layer and closure for n=3,4,5; this is finite supplementary evidence, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact idempotent rank of the largest proper ideal of the full-domain partition monoid is explicitly motivated by a published open question (East–Gray Section 4.5). The sharp minimum n(n-1) improves the later proven 3*C(n,2) explicit generator set and reveals a genuine two-layer obstruction (equivalence projections and oriented transformations) rather than a routine relabeling. The result is an infinite-family natural ideal invariant.
